dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So about the recent performance slate...

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: Did you not take a look at the schedule before coming down here? Or are you simply fishing around and hoping to start a conversation somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: But if you must know, my favorite piece from the recent shows would be "Death of the Ice Lake," without a doubt. In my opinion, it's an opera each and every person in Snezhnaya should attend.

dialogues.speaker: Osipova
dialogues.text: If that is all, please do not speak to me again.
